dial.summary: Macro backdrop holds constructive into mid-November — 5/8 indicators supportive (Global M2 $104.3T, ISM Mfg 55.5 on 10th expansion month, real yields declining to 2.63%, Fed balance sheet flat at $6.75T, BTC funding near zero) with DXY the lone headwind at 101.36 above the 100 threshold; BTC.D firms at ~59.3% and TOTAL recovers to ~$2.60T from the October 30 crash with no alt-rotation catalyst in sight; BOE deciding rates today and October NFP printing tomorrow as near-term macro catalysts; BTC Accumulation posture intact.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) holds at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317B; October data not yet published — MacroMicro typically updates mid-month following the reference month, so October G4 update expected mid-November 2026); US M2 at $23.41T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY) confirms no YoY contraction; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%) exceeds flat threshold — trend UP; Bitrue broader global estimate ~$103.66T; status supportive (4-week trend up); held unchanged from Nov 4 run — October G4 data publication pending mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, 2026), beating consensus 54.6%, up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive expansion month; Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Prices 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next ISM Manufacturing release December 1, 2026 (November data); value unchanged — monthly series, October reading is current.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot ~101.36 as of November 5, 2026 (Yahoo Finance DX-Y.NYB quote; Nov 4 close ~101.48 per EBC, 101.505 per Trading Economics); DXY under continued pressure from Democratic midterm sweep (Nov 3) reducing fiscal deficit expectations — EUR/USD and GBP/USD gaining; 4-week trend FLAT — from ~101.5-101.8 range (Oct 5-7) to 101.36 (Nov 5), net change approximately -0.3% within flat threshold; 52-week high 102.95 (Oct 14, 2026); status headwind (DXY above 100 — must fall below 97.5 for supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at approximately 2.63% as of early November 2026 (Macrotrends: 2.62% on Nov 2 citing Fed H.15; Tipsyield: 2.65% on Nov 3 from Treasury par curve); FRED API unavailable this session; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~2.93% on September 29 to ~2.63% on November 5, approximately -30bps; real yields fell as nominal 10Y dropped to 4.884% on Nov 3 (Democrat midterm sweep reducing fiscal deficit expectations); status supportive (falling trend); absolute level 2.63% remains restrictive but directional improvement clear into December 8-9 FOMC.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: November 3, 2026: 10Y 4.884% (-6bps), 2Y 4.573% (-4bps), spread ~+31bps (CNBC); 247WallSt reported +32bps on Nov 2 after a 6bp flattening; using +31bps from Nov 3 CNBC confirmed data; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~+42bps on October 1 to ~+31bps on November 5, -11bps flattening; Democrats winning both chambers pushed 10Y lower (fiscal restraint expectations) while 2Y remains sticky on December 8-9 FOMC hike odds; curve positive (well above -50bps headwind threshold); status neutral (positive but flattening, not steepening).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL latest: $6,745,635M ($6.75T) for week ended October 28, 2026 (prior H.4.1); Trading Economics calendar shows November 5, 2026 H.4.1 release (covering week ended Nov 4) with projected $6.746T — essentially unchanged; 4-week change from early Oct (~$6.743T) to Oct 28 ($6.745T) approximately +$2B, essentially flat; balance sheet stabilized post-QT-pause (QT ended December 1, 2025 at $6.536T); oscillating in a narrow ~$10B band; status supportive (flat, no aggressive QT, overnight rates stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass inaccessible (domain not reachable from cloud environment); ConvexTrade snapshot: 0.01% per 8h rate as of October 20, 2026; last confirmed snapshot from October 23 at ~0.0087% (prior run); post-October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations, 86.8% longs flushed) compressed funding toward near-zero; MacroMicro Bitcoin-Perpetual rate was 0.0067% on September 30; 30-day trend DOWN (declining from pre-crash elevated levels); status supportive (near zero, well below 0.04% headwind threshold); value held at last confirmed Oct 23 snapshot — skipped this run (direct data unavailable).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: DefiLlama stablecoin total market cap $292.967B as of November 4, 2026; total crypto market cap ~$2.60T (tv-hub.org; BTC.D ~59.3%); implied dominance $293B/$2.60T ≈ 11.3%; 30-day trend UP — October crash compressed TOTAL from $2.86T (Oct 1) to $2.60T (Nov 1) while stablecoins remained ~$293B; rising dominance reflects market cap compression, not stablecoin inflows; status neutral — headwind requires rising dom AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL declining from Oct crash so headwind condition not met; CoinGecko direct fetch unavailable this session.

upcoming.title: CPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Consumer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — dominant data print of the week and key input for December 8-9 FOMC dot plot; September CPI was 3.7% YoY; October ISM Manufacturing Prices Index at 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70) signals ongoing cost pressure; a deceleration toward 3.0% could accelerate the real yield decline and ease headwinds on risk assets; a sustained print above 3.5% reinforces the case for a December 25bp hike and keeps DXY above 100.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 8, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 8 — released Thursday November 12 (Veterans Day November 11 is a federal holiday; bond markets closed, equity and crypto open); first labor read after October NFP (Nov 6) and before PPI (Nov 13); context shaped by the Oct NFP result heading into the December FOMC blackout period (Nov 28).

upcoming.title: PPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Producer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — pipeline inflation signal; September PPI was 6.3% YoY; a sustained elevated print would confirm cost-push inflation feeding through to consumers and maintain the Fed's hawkish posture into December 8-9 meeting; completes the November inflation picture alongside CPI (Nov 10), providing a full input set for the December FOMC dot plot.
